easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Pirated Copy.
description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Pirated Copy enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Pirated Copy. Choose to have Pirated Copy enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
